name: dither-dissolve
title: Dither Dissolve
description: A two-color ordered-dither pattern rises over the outgoing scene, holds, and falls away to reveal the next one. Rebuilt with a deterministic Canvas 2D Bayer dither instead of the original WebGL shader. The block draws its own colored field between two built-in placeholder scenes A and B (the two .dtd-panel elements); to use it between your own scenes, replace the contents of those two panels and keep the block on a track above.
useWhen: Retro, pixel or print-inspired content that wants a gritty, graphic scene change.
A short cover transition where a patterned texture hides the swap.
avoidWhen: Clean corporate pieces: the dither texture reads as noise.
Photographic scenes where the pattern fights fine detail.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Multiplier for the pattern’s own motion.
